I went to school for a few years so I can read the labels on the fertilizer bags and seed packets, but I still copy what my neighbors and my uncle do because they know this soil. Last season I planted improved maize seed with one bag of DAP and some urea from the cooperative, and the cobs were much bigger than my father’s local seed, so I will do the same this year. Because this plot is rented, I will not haul manure here — I keep that for the land I own, and I will not borrow money for inputs because a bad harvest would ruin me. My younger brother and I will do all the work on this half-hectare ourselves; we do not have cash to pay laborers.
